question: How should the practitioner perform the thread-cutting using the fire seed-syllable?
premises: The rite requires cutting the thread.
The fire seed-syllable serves as the instrument.
The action must be performed on all sides.
inference: The practitioner should perform the thread-cutting on all sides by means of the fire seed-syllable.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the fire seed-syllable is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: One should perform the cutting of the thread on all sides using the fire seed-syllable.
